objective: Evaluate the owner-selected Candidate A against its official untouched control. Candidate B and its control are retired and excluded; owner selection does not establish T2 qualification.

suite.qualificationLimit: This suite is required regression evidence but is not a sealed holdout or sufficient by itself to qualify a foundation.

matchedRuntime.minimumReason: The same pinned runtime must be used for Candidate A and its official control.
matchedRuntime.runtimeRule: Use the same image digest, package lock, GPU type, dtype, context limit and server flags for the active candidate and its control.

tracks.purpose: Matched direct baseline without Veronica persona or native thinking.
Two recorded-seed repetitions to expose instability under matched chat sampling.

requiredEvidence: Pinned repository and revision, complete artifact manifest, byte counts and hashes
Exact image digest, package versions, tokenizer/chat-template hashes and server command
GPU identity, configured and observed context limit, parser settings and reasoning controls
Raw request and response for every planned sample, including errors and truncation
Objective checks, executable coding results in an isolated no-network sandbox, JSON/schema checks and native tool-call checks
Blind human review of every response with critical failures adjudicated
Per-category paired candidate-versus-control results, latency and token/cost measurements
A signed decision of selected, rejected or hold with all missing evidence visible

developmentGate.selectionPolicy: Any missing, unsupported, unreviewed or statistically inconclusive required evidence yields hold, never qualification.

explicitNonClaims: The existing Candidate A smoke conversation is not a T2 pass.
HTTP success, a model listing, nonempty text or self-reported execution is not capability evidence.
Published development cases are not sealed holdouts.
Owner selection is not evidence of foundation qualification.
Candidate B and its official control are retired and excluded from this protocol.
This protocol does not authorize paid compute, model downloads, transcript upload, training or foundation-weight changes.
